claims.statement: Management is confident in bringing growth into the Nagarro asset and maintaining its margins.
claims.quote: we are confident we'll bring the growth into the asset, and we'll maintain the margins.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects the transaction to be cash EPS accretive from Year 1.
claims.quote: become cash EPS accretive from Year 1, and remove the transactional expenses, even the reported EPS should be positive from Year 1.
claims.speaker: management
claims.target: positive reported EPS and cash EPS accretive

claims.statement: Management intends to use cash generation over time to repay some of the loans.
claims.quote: our intent is basically to see some of these loans are repaid to the cash generation that will be happening over a period of time.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management states that Persistent does not intend to enter into a domination and/or property loss transfer agreement for two years.
claims.quote: Persistent does not intend to enter into a domination and/or property loss transfer agreement for two years.
claims.speaker: management
claims.target: no domination or property loss transfer agreement

claims.statement: Management targets to integrate over the next two years and ultimately become one entity.
claims.quote: over a period of the next two years, look at where we can do the squeeze out. And we are in no hurry to do the squeeze out. We can do the squeeze out at the right period of time. Ultimately, it'll become one entity going ahead.
claims.speaker: management
claims.target: squeeze out and become one entity

facts.quote: the EBIT for CY25 for Nagarro is 10.9%.

facts.quote: we have grown from the time we went IPO at about 17.5% plus CAGR. If you look at the last five years in an industry where others have not grown, we have grown disproportionately. From our last five years CAGR perspective, we are at 23.9%.
